AI Notes.value: GANSCHOW is Sebastian Ganschow, a cinematographer and DP (also self-described glitchographer/photographer), born 1994 Hamburg, Filmakademie-trained, based Berlin and Hamburg, Germany. Commercial and film work: brands Gucci, Adidas, Oatly, plus music videos, fashion films and feature credits (The Girl in the Spider's Web, Snowflake). Received the Justus Pankau Camera Award 2025 for outstanding visual design in Filmakademie productions; also DP on feature Biermann (2025, post-production). Mid-level to rising DP, strong craft and a growing commercial roster; Autonomy 4 (shoots and lights his own projects, freelance hire on bigger productions). Work Status Freelance: own site gansc.how lists no employer, IG bio freelance-signals, LinkedIn lists 'Freiberuflich' (self-employed), Crew United and IMDB show no staff role; all sources agree. IG @sebastianganschow confirmed via his own listings. LinkedIn confirmed from Google snippet (Freiberuflich, Filmakademie education). Email saebba@jotes-creations.de from /about page of own site; jotes-creations.de is his own registered business entity. Capabilities from his site sections (Cinematography, Photography, Glitch).
